verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has nothing showing that EmailOctopus can connect to or consume external MCP servers. It documents a REST API and claims over 1,000 app integrations, but those are inbound or third-party integrations, not MCP-client capability. An email platform with built-in AI features could plausibly act as an MCP client, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
